item: Keyword and diagnostics files come in numbered parts of at most 1 MB, each opening on its own (R115)
status: shipped (browser-verified in the remote sandbox on Chromium; awaiting the human UX pass)
summary: Every file the app hands out for Keyword log, All keywords and All diagnostics is at most 1,000,000 bytes, opens alone in any unzip tool, and is named <stem>-part-NN-of-MM.zip beside a <stem>-manifest.zip listing every part with its size and SHA-256. A streaming zip writer closes a part before it can pass the cap and re-measures at the end; the keyword set is written rank-major so a partial upload is the top of every language; memory stays one batch whatever the number of languages. The page saves five files to a click with 'again' buttons and a part-number box for files that failed to upload, one rule says who keeps the parts bar when a build finishes, and the analyzer script reads a folder, one part or the manifest and skips a damaged part by name. On a 2M-keyword synthetic database the default set is 4 files and All keywords 21 files at the real cap, server peak 1.9 GB against 1.8 GB for the single zip.
